product_metadata.title: Prsildan Thanksgiving Tabletop Decorations, Set of 3 Resin Pumpkins Seasonal Fall Autumn Centerpieces for Table Room Kitchen Office (White)
features: 🎃 Adorable Pumpkins: Package includes 3 pcs white resin pumpkins with glittery finishing on the surface. Their sizes are different from each other, 5.5" x 4", 5" x 4.3" and 4" x 4". This set of lovely pumpkins is a great addition to your house.

⭐ High Quality: Our set of 3 pumpkins are made of premium resin, with detailed workmanship, brightly colored, they are durable, long-lasting and never fade, can be used for years. The straw bows on the stems make the pumpkins more attractive.

🌼 Thanksgiving Decor: As the most popular decorations for Thanksgiving and Harvest Day, our yellow pumpkins with various sayings on them are perfect for home decorating. The blessings "Be Thankful", "Be Joyful" and "Give Thanks" are the best wishes for your family.

🎁 Ideal Gifts: Our handmade pumpkins are perfect for you to present friends and co-workers as holiday gifts like Thanksgiving, Halloween, birthday and housewarming. They can easily provide a warm and festive atmosphere for the gift-receivers.

☘️ Widely Use: You can display our orange pumpkins in various way such as table centerpieces, dinning table, Fall wedding, Autumn theme party and Thanksgiving or Halloween decorations. Also can use them with other ornaments like candles and flowers for a beautiful table scape.
